notes.title: Development Update: Progress, Graphics, and Demo News 🚀
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It’s been a while since our last update, but we’ve been working tirelessly behind the scenes to bring this game closer to our vision. Here's what's new:

1️⃣ Updated Trailer & Screenshots – We’ve revamped the graphics to a whole new level, and you can check out the improved visuals on our Steam page now!

2️⃣ Most of Core Mechanics Completed – The foundation of the game is solid and running smoothly, giving us the perfect base to refine and expand upon.

3️⃣ Multiplayer Progress – There’s a good base for multiplayer in place, and we’re steadily building toward an exciting co-op experience.

4️⃣ Demo Release Incoming – We’re thrilled to announce that we’re approaching a major milestone: the demo! Stay tuned for the exact date—it’s closer than you think.

Starting now, we’ll be posting updates regularly to keep you in the loop about what’s happening behind the scenes. Thank you for sticking with us—we can’t wait to share more with you soon.

We’re also excited to share that we’ll be back posting regular devlogs on YouTube for those who want an inside look at the development process, including progress updates, challenges, and sneak peeks. The next devlog will be out on January 8th!

Thank you for your patience and support—it means the world to us.

See you in the skies!

✨ Don’t forget to wishlist the game and follow for updates!
